origin: Original native link ownership contract inferred from pinned upstream protocol; no upstream code or fixture content copied.
scope: Source-only Swift MainActor / Kotlin enforced constructor-thread owner around injected Noise and typed decoded packet handoff; no authentication, cryptography, network, vault, FFI linkage, UI, services, models, retries or reconnect.
trustPrerequisites: Caller has verified account membership, enrolled Client identity, Host role, pinned Host identity and durable trust before constructing enrollment.
Typed enrollment and packet-port connectionInfo are contextual inputs, not evidence enrollment or authentication actually occurred.
All connection/client/host identifiers are nonempty, NUL-free, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; malformed Kotlin UTF-16 is rejected.
Prepared inner local Client / remote Host IDs and business binding Host must match enrollment before Noise factory. Kotlin authenticated context also binds connection ID and caller Client ID.
Identifiers are opaque exact UTF-8 byte strings: composed/decomposed Unicode sequences never compare equal. Business binding identity also uses byte-exact optional workspace/session matching.

noise.handshake: Send step 1; accept exactly step 2 with matching connection/Client target; provider must complete with empty application payload and no response.
noise.deadlineStart: After connection info/factory/counter preflight, immediately before initiate; monotonic 9999ms accepted, 10000ms expired.
noise.counterRules: Packet counter is sampled before encrypt. Provider send/receive must advance exactly one, with complete state and exact owner-expected counters checked before and after each operation. Counter maximum cannot be used when its successor would exceed the safe range. No nonce setters.
noise.faultPolicy: Every active-generation decrypt/tag, counter, fragment or business-observer failure retires the whole link, even if the injected primitive permits tag-failure continuation.

packetSeam.futureAdapterOwns: Actual packet JSON, canonical unpadded Base64URL, 64 KiB control / 1 MiB relay JSON caps, authenticated WSS, bounded socket backpressure and asynchronous failure callbacks retaining exact original generation.
packetSeam.sendMeaning: Synchronous bounded handoff only, not evidence bytes reached a network or peer. A handoff may accept then throw; retire without replay.

business.outbound: Existing business port -> whole-message FIFO -> existing DSHF framing -> injected encrypt each frame -> typed relay handoff.
business.inbound: Validate generation, connection, Client target and exact receive counter -> injected decrypt -> existing DSHF assembly -> business observer.
business.serialization: A reentrant send reserves and enqueues its complete message; active fragment batches never interleave.
business.authenticatedCallback: Ready state is reserved before invoking observer, allowing immediate coordinator connect/describe/send.

lifecycle.generation: Strictly increasing positive local generation; reserve watermark before old retirement. Kotlin uses signed Long; Swift caps UInt64 generation at Int64.max for fragment compatibility.
lifecycle.reentrancy: Session reference identity is checked after injected factory/Noise/packet/clock/active-observer calls. An old continuation cannot retire or deliver into a replacement.
lifecycle.retirement: Clear session, queues and fragments before shutdown, exact-generation port retirement and retired observer. Idempotent; injected diagnostic text is never propagated.
lifecycle.teardownUnconfirmed: Set pending generation before cleanup callbacks. A throwing mandatory port retirement blocks begin. Trusted confirmRetired accepts only the exact pending local generation after actual channel/Host cleanup, is ignored during cleanup, and is never sourced from peer packet fields. No automatic retries.
lifecycle.deadlines: Caller must invoke checkDeadlines with original generation during idle periods. Reject monotonic regressions and handshake-addition overflow. Stale handshake/data/timer/close/send/invalidate cannot alter replacement.
lifecycle.privacy: Swift descriptions, debug descriptions and CustomMirror redact stored IDs/bytes/business values. Kotlin ordinary descriptions redact values; privileged JVM reflection is not a confidentiality boundary. Errors expose stable local codes only. Explicit byte/value getters are private-data exports.
lifecycle.serialization: Swift MainActor isolation; Kotlin captures constructor Thread and rejects every public state API/getter on any other thread before state access. Packet callbacks and coordinator calls must dispatch to the same owner thread. No secure-link monitor is held across coordinator callbacks; wrong-thread failure does not retire a link.

verification.provider: Original deterministic fake: plaintext plus sixteen zero marker bytes. It is not cryptography.
verification.proof: Native source-only lifecycle, ordering, counter, fault and coordinator seam assertions. Markers appear once only after every case assertion succeeds.
verification.remaining: Hosted Swift execution, maintained Rust facade linkage, real Noise interoperability, enrollment/vault/account trust, actual JSON/Base64URL/WSS/backpressure, simulator/device UI and inference remain separate checks.
